audience: merchants and finance teams who take card payments with Viva.com

useCases.title: Check the status of one payment
useCases.text: Look up a card or wallet transaction by its id. Read its amount, status, order code and card scheme before you answer a customer.

useCases.title: Review wallet activity for a period
useCases.text: List the merchant wallets to get their ids. Then search the account transactions of one wallet between two dates.

useCases.title: Check the balance of each merchant wallet
useCases.text: List the merchant wallets on the account with their currency and current balance.

useCases.title: Create a payment order for a customer
useCases.text: Create a payment order for a customer and get its order code. No money moves until the customer pays it on Viva's checkout.
